Inside, three sections are stacked vertically: (1) header 'Popular Languages for ML/DL' with 3 bullets: Python, R, Matlab; (2) header 'Popular Platforms for ML/DL' with 2 bullets: Tensor Flow, Pytorch; (3) header 'Popular Libraries (for python)' with 6 bullets: SciKit Learn, SciPy, NLTK, Spacy, Gensim, OpenCV. All bullets use small round black bullet points, indented one level under their headers. A white mouse-cursor arrow overlaps the 'Spacy' bullet line.

Section headers inside the box are bold red (~18pt), sentence case. Bullet items are regular weight, near-black (~16-18pt), each preceded by a small round bullet and indented one level. No italics, no all-caps, no numbered lists. Note verbatim spellings preserved: 'Matlab', 'Tensor Flow' (two words), 'Pytorch', 'SciKit Learn', 'Spacy', '(for python)' lowercase p.

Add a centered title text box at top: 'Programming Languages, Platforms, and Libraries', bold, red (#C00000), ~40pt sans-serif (Arial), wrapped so line 1 reads 'Programming Languages, Platforms,' and line 2 reads 'and Libraries'. 4. Draw a white-filled rectangle with a thin red (#C00000) border on the left half: left ~7%, top ~28%, width ~41%, height ~65%. 5. Inside the rectangle, add one text frame with three sections. Section headers in bold red (#C00000) ~18pt: 'Popular Languages for ML/DL', 'Popular Platforms for ML/DL', 'Popular Libraries (for python)'. 6. Under each header, add round-bulleted items in near-black (#1A1A1A) ~16-18pt, indented one level: under Languages: 'Python', 'R', 'Matlab'; under Platforms: 'Tensor Flow', 'Pytorch'; under Libraries: 'SciKit Learn', 'SciPy', 'NLTK', 'Spacy', 'Gensim', 'OpenCV'. Preserve the exact spellings listed. 7. Leave the entire right half of the slide empty. 8. Do not add footer, slide number, or watermark. 9. Optionally, for full archival fidelity, place a small white mouse-cursor arrow icon overlapping the 'Spacy' bullet (recording artifact). 10. Ignore the black bottom strip — it belongs to the video player, not the slide.
